strings.objective.c01.stow_equipment: Stow the equipment at the van
strings.objective.c01.extract: Gather at the van to finish

strings.tablet.title: Network tablet
strings.tablet.subtitle: Measured paths and limits. Inspect a junction panel to get reliable evidence.
strings.tablet.footnote: Physical switches operate in the world
strings.network.refused.rate_limited: Too many actions; wait a moment
strings.accessibility.title: Accessibility
strings.guide.step.move: Move around the van and look for dark service buildings.
strings.guide.step.measure: Equip your meter and inspect a reachable junction panel.
strings.guide.step.isolate: Use measured evidence to identify the unsafe path, then isolate the panel.
strings.guide.step.repair: Follow the repair steps, test the result, and confirm that supply returns.
strings.guide.hint.move.1: Look around the street before using a tool.
strings.guide.hint.move.2: Move with the movement controls and use the reticle to aim.
strings.guide.hint.move.3: The dark buildings need power. Explore nearby service panels.
strings.guide.hint.measure.1: A dark light is a symptom, not a diagnosis.
strings.guide.hint.measure.2: Choose the meter, approach a panel, and read its evidence.
strings.guide.hint.measure.3: Unknown readings are not zero. Compare measured results with the network tablet.
strings.guide.hint.isolate.1: A panel cannot be repaired safely while its feed is live.
strings.guide.hint.isolate.2: Use the measurement to decide which path to isolate.
strings.guide.hint.isolate.3: The host validates isolation before allowing the next repair step.
strings.guide.hint.repair.1: Repairs have multiple durable steps, not one long hold.
strings.guide.hint.repair.2: Follow the panel prompt and use the required tool.
strings.guide.hint.repair.3: After replacing a part, close and test the panel before restoring supply.
